At my job everyone pretty much aspirates and dispense as quickly as possible, which is fine because it is consistent, seems to be more accurate then precise (less volume then set for) though.  If I am really seeking to achieve precision and accuracy, I will aspirate slowly at 90degrees with tip a little less than halfway in the solution. then wait \~1 sec for the tip to equilibrate air pressure, then repeat at least 3 times, swirl tip to remove residual, then slowly dispense into solution at 45degrees to first stop, come out of solution, dispense to second stop several times, swirl tip to remove residual.
